selection: All cases, forms, arms and repetitions retained; no minimum selection. Full executable, frozen source, compile commands and assembly recoverable through artifact.json.

checks.borrowed: all-width/all-kind bucket-read permissions, promotion, bags, deletion, reuse, and refusal passed
checks.local: all-width/all-kind bucket-read permissions, promotion, bags, deletion, reuse, and refusal passed
checks.recipe: recipe exact and widened access, guard thresholds, poisoned neighbors, independent bytes, damage and refusal passed

borrowed.phase_assignment: DWARF inline caller locations matched to frozen source assignments; no clock ordinal or lambda number

local.phase_assignment: DWARF inline caller locations matched to frozen source assignments; no clock ordinal or lambda number

limitations: Single-writer exclusive-owner experiment. No concurrent writer, MVCC publication, DRAM, Loom prefetch or established cache-residence claim.

This compares complete caller codegen: borrowed checksum versus local result returned at loop end. Baseline loops change too, including metadata/constant hoisting, branch and whole-loop outlining. It does not isolate one checksum memory store.

Same frozen source and flags build both contenders on each host. All45 cases and arms0/1/8/9 retained. Paired process order is randomized with seed127 (borrowed first86 pairs; local first94); case order is shuffled. Nine repetitions each have fresh Pool and complete read warmup. Process placement, temporal drift and Abseil seed differences remain.

K8..64, set/map/multimap, A6/A10 except K8A6 only, exact arbitrary-fit bucket recipes. Cardinality follows the explicit historical capacity control; formats are not compared at their own equal occupancy. K8 bypasses compact-list policy.
Direct replaces bucket-field operations only; owner, hashing, routing and chains stay common. It is not an independent whole table.

Timing uses std::chrono::steady_clock. Hit/miss results have independent per-key checks. Map serial depends on values; multimap XORs all values and proves the complete cycle; set serial includes caller dependency.
Full lifetime sums separately timed construct/build/update/erase/release. Reads, inventories, checks and Pool setup/drain are excluded. This is not uninterrupted lifetime throughput.

Requested bytes, owned backing and metadata are separate. Logical bytes=requested+metadata. Baseline owned_capacity zero means unknown, not measured zero. RSS, transient peaks and residence are not established. Per-repetition logical bytes, geometry, populations and operations match between caller forms.

Inventory is after build for construct/build/read, after update for update, and after erase for erase/release/lifecycle. Population fields always describe build. Data backing histories are retained but equality is not assumed.

Abseil reserves known cardinality in construct. Its InlinedVector<word,1> actually holds two inline values on these ABIs; candidate holds one. Multimap append allocation asymmetry remains and is not the separate admitted-append experiment.
Host ISA and microarchitecture change together (Zen5 AVX2 x86-64-v3, Granite native AVX512, V2 NEON); this is not an ISA-only comparison.

Complete timed CFG and helper audit resolves phase through frozen-source DWARF callsites, including outlined timers. It establishes call boundaries, not runtime branch frequency, PMU profiling or cycle causality. Medians across cases are descriptive; no default or preset is selected.
Earlier access and later prepared captures change other owner/driver bytes; only borrowed/local within this cohort is the matched reduction comparison.
